answer: Bonded escrow keeps capital at risk under each identity, so splitting stake among sybils does not erase aggregate exposure. If k coordinated identities equivocate on shared consensus evidence, pairwise attribution yields up to k(k−1)/2 slashing penalties, scaling as O(k²). Repeated detection compounds asymmetric depreciation, creating an exponential multiplier in total capital loss. “River,” “mirror,” and “orchard” may be labels, but they do not conceal coordination.
